# AORUS Gen4 7000s Prem. SSD 1TB

GP-AG70S1TB-P

## Key Features

Top Gen4 SSD Performance 7000 MB/s Seq. Read With No Throttling

2nd Generation PCIe 4.0x4 Controller

The 2nd generation PCIe 4.0 controller PS5018-E18 deliver sequential read/write up to 7GB/s with 3D TLC NAND Flash. The E18 controller is built with the advanced 12nm process ensuring sufficient computing power. Also it supports up to 8 NAND Flash channel with 32CE, DDR4 caching and meets NVMe 1.4. 

- + PCIe 4.0x4, NVMe 1.4 Interface
- + DDR4 DRAM cache
- + 8 CH with 32 CEs
- + Phison 4th Gen LDPC
- + Support AES-256 Encryption
- + Thermal Throttle Protection

Selected High Speed 3D TLC NAND Flash (1200MT/s)

 The 3D TLC NAND Flash(96L) is operating at 1200MT/s, Which is 50 % more than the prevision version that leads to better performance.

Xtreme Storage Performance

With 2nd generation PCIe 4.0 controller PS5018-E18, AORUS Gen4 7000s Prem. SSD delivers blazing speeds: up to 7,000 MB/s for sequential read, and up to 5,500MB/s sequential Write*. Sequential Read performance of PCIe 4.0 SSDs is up to 2 times faster than the PCIe 3.0 SSDs. Get ready to enter the next generation of computing with faster and smoother, gaming, streaming, and graphics intensive rendering.

M.2 Thermal Guard XTREME with Nanocarbon Coating

 M.2 Thermal Guard XTREME is made up of two heatpipes and stacked fins with advanced thermal technology Nanocarbon coating for maximum heat dissipation efficiency. The M.2 Thermal Guard XTREME is the best solution in passive airflow condition when your personal computer adopts CPU AIO water cooler.
